task_title: Fix promoteExactBatch sibling-cleanup coupling on postcondition failure

plan_review.summary: Independent-model plan review of the promoteExactBatch sibling-cleanup fix. Found one blocking gap: only the waitForMergedPr=false path was decoupled from cleanup; other post-push exceptions (confirmation-read errors, postcondition-check publish errors, per-entry cleanup errors) could still abort the tail and re-strand confirmed siblings. Resolved by restructuring the entire post-push phase to collect-and-continue (parallelized confirmation polling, try/catch around postcondition-check publish, per-entry try/catch around cleanup), aggregating all failures into one final error. Reviewer also flagged the sequential polling worst-case time (fixed by parallelizing) and noted a stale-state repair sweep as a good non-blocking follow-up (deferred, documented in ADR/issue).
